---
title: "Default listing, description with a link"
listing:
  id: description-links
  type: default
  contents:
    - path: https://example.com/article
      title: "Article"
      description: "Read the article, see the [docs](https://example.org/docs)."
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # the description stays inside the link to the item
          - ".quarto-listing-container-default .listing-description > a[href='https://example.com/article'] span"
        -
          # the link must be removed, not nested in the item's wrapping <a>
          - ".quarto-listing-container-default .listing-description a[href='https://example.org/docs']"
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # the link text is kept
          - '<span>docs</span>'
---

::: {#description-links}
:::

The default listing wraps the item description in a link to the item. A link
inside the description would nest one `<a>` in another, which the HTML parser
splits into empty, unnamed links. The description link must be turned into
plain text instead.
